messages.subject: Update packages corrupted Deducer
parts:
Hi all,

This is frustrating...

I made the mistake of using update.packages()
Now Deducer does not work as expected.

Trying a plot had an error message that part of ggplot2 was not present?

Tried to install Deducer with current version of R with
install.packages("Deducer",,"http://rforge.net")
Had error message 'Deducer' is not available (for R version 3.0.2)

In order to get back onto being able to use Deducer (and yes I am
Deducer DEPENDANT user of R...LOL) I ended up using the same old Windows
Installer version from the Deducer web site.

Hope there is not a 12 step program to ween folks off of Deducer as it
allows old farts w/o the R moxie to get our work done...

Bruce
